* First printed in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “* = 1 or number of Jedi on table (to a maximum of 3), whichever is higher. Mace’s forfeit may not be reduced and his total weapon destiny is +1. If a Dark Jedi was just lost from table, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF made 19 December 2011), Light Side p. 3, page 3, slip 15 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>
* The PC website card list (Virtual Block 7 and Virtual Master lists, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows the same text (it writes the title “Mace Windu, Master of the Order”).<ref name="cl-1274_15-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
